verdict.rationale: Netlify documents a first-party REST API for managing sites, deploys, DNS "and more" programmatically, plus an official CLI for deploying and managing projects, so substantial programmatic control exists. Nothing in the evidence shows the API covers everything the UI does. Dashboard features such as prompting AI agents and the visual preview environment have no documented API equivalent, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec at the checked docs paths. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a published machine-readable API spec, documented API coverage of dashboard-only features (agent runs, team/security settings, analytics), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Manage sites, deploys, DNS, and more programmatically with the Netlify REST API—ideal for automating workflows and integrating into your systems.
Deploy sites, run local dev servers, and manage your Netlify projects right from the terminal with this powerful command-line tool.
